title: Execution
description: Controls when and how the order becomes solvable. `enableFastPath` opts into out-of-competition ("fast path") execution; `validFrom` delays when the order may enter an auction. The two are mutually exclusive.

enableFastPath.title: Enable Fast Path
enableFastPath.description: Opt into out-of-competition ("fast path") execution: the winning quote's solver can settle the order directly, within a short exclusivity window, instead of waiting for the next auction. Mutually exclusive with `validFrom`.

validFrom.title: Valid From
validFrom.description: Earliest time, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds, at which the order may enter an auction. Mutually exclusive with `enableFastPath`: a fast-path order ignores it, as the backend controls its window.
